instruction: I find the fullscreen controller in VLC distracting. Can you disable it so the controls don't appear when I'm watching videos in fullscreen?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
